accused_gender.reason: Appellant is referred to with male pronouns throughout, e.g. 'his statement'.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for the accused anywhere in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states he was a regular taxi driver.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased Jagdish Prasad is referred to in the male form.

victim_age.quote: No age of the deceased appears in the judgment.
victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the deceased.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased had occupied a taxi, in which some persons were already sitting
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Relationship is not described; 'Stranger' is not supported by the judgment.

offence_category.reason: Offence is dacoity with murder and murder under s.302, so murder fits.

statutory_provisions.reason: Ss.396, 201 charged and 302, 201 convicted match the judgment, though 392/391 are also discussed.

weapon.reason: Injuries were caused by a sharp-edged weapon.

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial evidence; recovery of body; witness testimony (PW2, PW4, PW3, IO); accused's statement under s.313
evidence_type.quote: This is admittedly a case of circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: No dying declaration is mentioned; the evidence was circumstantial, recovery, and witness testimony.

confession.correct_value: Pre-trial confession led to recovery of body; the s.313 statement was a complete denial, considered as a relevant consideration
confession.quote: had taken up a stand of complete denial in his statement recorded under Section 313
confession.reason: The s.313 statement was a denial; the confession was a police confession leading to recovery.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Sharp weapon, body concealment and knowledge of likely death are all noted by the court.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted appellant under ss.302 and 201 IPC.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court maintained appellant's conviction and acquitted Ahsan of s.411.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, upholding conviction.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction under s.302 IPC was upheld as the offence established.

imprisonment_type.quote: rigorous imprisonment for life to Rafiq Ahmad under Section 302 IPC
imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence under s.302 was life imprisonment, not a fixed term.

imprisonment_years.quote: rigorous imprisonment for life to Rafiq Ahmad under Section 302 IPC and seven years rigorous imprisonment under Section 201 IPC
imprisonment_years.reason: Ten years is not the sentence; s.302 was life imprisonment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine amount for the appellant is stated.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without stating the trial or HC conviction outcomes
neutral_facts.quote: The trial court convicted the accused for murder, and the High Court upheld the conviction
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are broadly accurate, but the summary reveals the trial and High Court outcomes, which it must not.

offence_severity.correct_value: s.302: death or life imprisonment; s.396: death, life, or RI up to ten years with fine
offence_severity.quote: every one of those persons shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: Omits death penalty under s.302 and the s.396 range; life minimum for s.302 is right.

attempt_completion.reason: Murder was completed; the body was found and death caused.

physical_harm.reason: Three incised wounds, three abrasions and severing of trachea are stated.

number_of_offences.reason: Charged under ss.396 and 201; convicted under ss.302 and 201, as stated.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Cash and valuables looted from the deceased (per High Court finding)
financial_property_loss.quote: looted the cash and other valuables from the person of the deceased
financial_property_loss.reason: The High Court found cash and valuables were looted, so loss is not 'not applicable'.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court found accused knew injuries were likely to cause death; premeditation not discussed
premeditation_planning.quote: indicate that the accused knew that the injury inflicted would be sufficient in the ordinary course of nature to cause death
premeditation_planning.reason: Knowledge finding is stated, but no premeditation or planning is addressed.

motive.correct_value: Robbery/dacoity: looting cash and valuables from the deceased
motive.quote: committed dacoity in Ambassador Car No.UPS 7293
motive.reason: The judgment identifies dacoity and looting of cash as the motive, not 'not identified'.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Last-seen witnesses, IO, PW3 and recovery memo evidence are accepted as the chain of events.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court treated last-seen and recovery witnesses' statements as material; no detailed credibility assessment
witness_credibility.quote: PW2 and PW4 were the witnesses who had last seen the deceased with the appellant
witness_credibility.reason: Court did not explicitly assess credibility; it relied on statements as material evidence.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Concealed body in sugarcane field; complete denial under s.313; did not explain whereabouts
post_offence_conduct.quote: opted not to explain his whereabouts at the relevant time
post_offence_conduct.reason: Concealment of the body and refusal to explain whereabouts are stated as post-offence conduct.

trial_duration.correct_value: Not stated (no trial duration given; only procedural history)
trial_duration.quote: The trial court convicted the appellant under Sections 302 and 201 IPC.
trial_duration.reason: Describes procedural outcomes rather than any duration; the duration itself is not given.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellant: R. Anand Padmanabhan, Prithvi Raj B.N., G. Ramakrishna Prasad; Respondent: T.N. Singh, Rajeev Dubey, Kamlendra Mishra, Jatinder Kumar Bhatia
legal_representation.quote: R. Anand Padmanabhan, Prit~vi Raj B.N., G. Ramakrishna Prasad for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names are stated in the judgment, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

investigation_status.reason: Case registered, charge-sheet filed under s.173, and trial completed.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Argued charge under s.396 but convicted under s.302 without alteration; court found no prejudice
procedural_irregularity.quote: without reformulation/alteration of the charge, he was convicted for offence u/s.302
procedural_irregularity.reason: Alleged irregularity (no alteration of charge) was argued; court held it caused no prejudice.

appeal_history.correct_value: HC upheld trial court's s.396 acquittal of four accused, acquitted Ahsan of s.411, and upheld appellant's conviction; SC dismissed
appeal_history.quote: The judgment of the trial court was upheld by the High Court in so far as the acquittal of the four accused for the offences under Section 396 was concerned
appeal_history.reason: Attributes the s.396 acquittals to the High Court's own action, though they were trial court acquittals upheld.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State contended appellant suffered no prejudice and that prosecution proved its case beyond reasonable doubt despite circumstantial evidence
prosecution_argument.quote: The appellant has suffered no prejudice, whatsoever, because of his conviction under Section 302 of the IPC.
prosecution_argument.reason: Value gives the defence's argument as the prosecution's; the State argued no prejudice.

defence_argument.reason: Accurately reflects the appellant's argument on charge alteration and prejudice.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Cognate offences principle with independent satisfaction of lesser offence ingredients is stated.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Willie Slaney, Iman Ali and Shyam Behari are relied upon as stated (list not exhaustive).

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Not stated (no sentencing reasoning; court addressed conviction under s.302)
sentencing_rationale.quote: The prosecution was able to establish its case beyond reasonable doubt on the basis of the circumstantial evidence.
sentencing_rationale.reason: Describes conviction reasoning, not any sentencing rationale.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are identified by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Nature of injuries (three incised wounds, trachea severed) showing knowledge of likely death; no sentencing aggravators stated
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: indicate that the accused knew that the injury inflicted would be sufficient in the ordinary course of nature to cause death
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court noted injuries indicating knowledge of death, which is inconsistent with 'None'.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Seven years RI under s.201, sentences ordered to run concurrently
other_sentence_order.quote: seven years rigorous imprisonment under Section 201 IPC. Both the sentences were ordered to run concurrently.
other_sentence_order.reason: Trial court imposed seven years under s.201 running concurrently; 'None' is wrong.
